messages:
Maya: Quick resilience game-day follow-up — threading all outstanding postmortem action items into one tracker. Goal: owners + target dates by EOD. Main buckets: multi-region routing policies, backup/restore runbook edits + dry-run, and recurring-incident detection/alert tuning.
Samir: I can own the multi-region routing policy updates. Deliverable: annotated policy + test plan. Target: draft by 2026-04-05. Need last topology export from @Olivia. :point_up:
Olivia: grabbing topology now, will drop export and a diagram link here in a sec: https://internal.redwood/wiki/infra/topology/export-2026-03-23 (private). Also adding notes on the LB weight skew we saw during failover.
Dan: I will take backups & restore runbook. Plan: update runbook with explicit AWS restore steps, test checklist, and postmortem learnings. Schedule a dry-run restore during the Wed maintenance window (2026-04-08 02:00 UTC). Will create a runbook PR.
Hannah: I'll handle recurring incident pattern detection and alert tuning. Action items: add a sliding-window anomaly detector on routing flaps + weekly incident rollup dashboard. Target: alerts in staging by 2026-04-02.
Samir: Quick question — for the test plan I want to include a simulated region outage + gradual DNS failover test. Who owns DNS TTL changes and who can approve the TTL drop? @Dan can you coordinate with netops?
Dan: I can coordinate. Netops contact is Priya — I'll loop her in and request a temporary TTL change to 30s for the game day tests.
Maya: remediation-bot, can you create tickets for each owner with the targets above?
remediation-bot: Created tickets: RI-4201 (Multi-region routing policy) -> Samir, due 2026-04-05; RI-4202 (Backup & restore runbook + dry-run) -> Dan, due 2026-04-09; RI-4203 (Recurring-incident detection + alerts) -> Hannah, due 2026-04-02.
Olivia: FYI I've attached the export + a short note about yesterday's KV cache priming issue — might affect routing test results. Will mark that as a test caveat in the topology doc.
Samir: Thanks. I'll include a pre-test KV cache warmup step in the test plan: run `curl -X POST https://routing-test.redwood/api/warmup -d '{"prefix":"/chat"}'` before failover.
Hannah: For the retrospective metrics, should we include token-level latency spikes and model fallback counts? I can add both, plus a correlation heatmap between region latency and failover events.
Maya: Yes — include token-level latency and fallback counts. Also add a short section on "what success looks like" for the game day (SLOs and rollback criteria).
Dan: Quick note on restore dry-run: we'll run restores into a staging account to validate data integrity and perf. Adding a checksum verification step to runbook.
Maya: Outstanding open risks: (1) DNS change approval time, (2) potential stale KV cache affecting test validity, (3) on-call staffing for game day. Please add mitigation notes to each ticket.
Samir: Adding mitigation: fallback policy to route to next-best region and a short circuit to return informative 503 when routing tables inconsistent.
Olivia: I'll add a pre-game connectivity checklist and mark required on-call engineers.
Hannah: I'll schedule a brief cross-team sync (30m) on 2026-04-06 to review runbook and test plan. Invitees: Maya, Samir, Dan, Olivia, Priya (netops).
Maya: OK — summarize owners and deadlines: Samir -> multi-region routing policy + test plan (RI-4201) due 2026-04-05; Dan -> backups & restore runbook + dry-run (RI-4202) dry-run 2026-04-08, ticket due 2026-04-09; Hannah -> recurring-incident detection + alerts (RI-4203) due 2026-04-02; Olivia -> topology export + caveats (linked in ticket). Please update your tickets with progress and add small PRs for runbook changes. :thumbsup:
Dan: ack, will put the runbook PR up today.
Samir: ack, starting policy draft now.
Olivia: ack, topology link in RI-4201 and RI-4202.
Hannah: ack, will send calendar invite.
Maya: thanks everyone. We'll re-check status in the 2026-04-06 sync. If anything slips, flag here.
